status_copy: A unique, format-validated GeoTIFF is ready to upload. It is the emission of a 4-fold, quadrant-blocked out-of-fold ensemble over 234 label-free structural features: all 19 GEMS bands plus the public 1 m LiDAR scarp product and the GeoDAWN radiometric/extension products. 37,000 binary pixels, 3 px Poisson-disk spacing, every pixel at least 600 m from the nearest catalogued fault (0.0% of mass within 300 m). It shares at most 1.6% of its pixels (Jaccard) with any prior artifact recovered in this workspace. No organizer score exists for it yet.

forecast.reading: All three models read geometry, not the ranking field, and the local holdouts cannot certify the ranking. The upside case is that the multi-physics field concentrates the same stand-off geometry on better structures; the downside case is that it is no better than the ridge field it replaces. Nothing here is an organizer score.

persistence_stability.citation: Stability is the number of smoothing scales (100/200/400/800 m) at which the cell remains in the top 5 % of the scale's edge response; the persistence-stability guarantee for the bottleneck distance between persistence diagrams under bounded field perturbation is Cohen-Steiner, Edelsbrunner & Harer, Discrete Comput. Geom. 37 (2007) 103-120, doi:10.1007/s00454-006-1276-5.
